items.title: Online Gaming License Application form: PAGE 1: QUESTION 4
items.description: The business model in Question 4 is missing. Kindly select a business model in Question 4 and resubmit the form.

items.title: Ivan Panic: Personal History Disclosure Enclosures: Birth Certificate
items.description: The enclosed document, Copy of Birth Certificate is not clear. Kindly submit a translated version in english.

items.title: Ivan Panic: Personal History Disclosure Enclosure: Proof of Address
items.description: The enclosed proof of address document is expired. Kindly resubmit a recent proof of address document or bank statement no older than 6 months

items.title: Ivan Panic: Personal History Disclosure Enclosure: Bank Reference
items.description: The enclosed document, proof of funding is not from a credit institution/ bank reference or bank statement. Kindly submit a reference or statement not older than 6 months

items.title: Online Gaming License Application form: PAGE6: QUESTION 34
items.description: In the Online gaming application form, contact person as the portal administrator must be a local representative, local manager or proxy holder,(with board declaration stating the rights of the proxy holder). Kindly change to the appointed contact person and resubmit the form

items.title: Online Gaming License Application form: PAGE 7: DECLARATION AND DATA PRIVACY
items.description: The Online gaming application form must have the Declaration and data privacy on page 7 named and signed by the proxy holder. Kindly correct the Declaration and resubmit the Form.

items.title: Online Gaming License Application Form: PAGE 6: QUESTION 36
items.description: Kindly adapt the answer to question 36 to match the answer of question 34, that has to match the portal user (authorized representative).

items.title: Online Gaming License Application Form: PAGE 6: QUESTION 37
items.description: Kindly adapt the answer to question 37 to match the answer of question 34, that has to match the portal user (authorized representative).

items.title: Online Gaming License Application Form: PAGE 6: QUESTION 38
items.description: Kindly adapt the answer to question 38 to match the answer of question 34, that has to match the portal user (authorized representative).

items.title: Online Gaming License Application Form: PAGE 6: QUESTION 35
items.description: Kindly adapt the answer to question 35 to match the answer of question 34, that has to match the portal user (authorized representative).

items.title: Online Gaming License Application form: New portal administrator
items.description: Kindly send via egl mail (egl-applications@gcb.cw) the name and email address of the new portal admin

items.title: QPA/2024/03005 - Ivan Panic - PHDF
items.description: The source of wealth section is incomplete.

items.title: QPA/2024/03005 - Ivan Panic - SOW
items.description: SOW is not valid. Please submit a SOW along with certified supporting evidence in order to support the business.

items.title: QPA/2024/03005 - Ivan Panic - Proof of address
items.description: Upload a more recent utility bill.

items.title: QPA/2024/03005 - Ivan Panic - PHDF
items.description: The source of wealth section is incomplete.

items.title: Corporate Structure
items.description: The corporate structure is unsigned. Resubmit signed by director.

items.title: Financial Statements
items.description: The balance sheet submitted is unsigned. Resubmit signed by director. Submit also financials for years ending 2023, which must not be older than 6 months.

items.title: Share Ledger Certification
items.description: Share ledger is uncertified. Resubmit duly certified.

items.title: Director's Register
items.description: 1. No local director appointed. A local executive director, resident in Curacao, is required to be appointed and to submit their PHDF. 2. The director's register is uncertified. Upon appointing a local director, submit an updated certified extract from the Curacao Commercial Register showing the directors of the company

items.title: Business Plan
items.description: The business plan, together with a detailed 3 year financial forecast is missing. Please review guidelines on business plan in order to include all the required information and submit a business plan accordingly.

items.title: Source of Funds of Business
items.description: Resubmit the SOF declaration, duly certified. Submit further enhanced documentation which show how the business is funded and by whom, including evidence of the funding by the shareholder.

items.title: Business and Corporate Information Form
items.description: Question 8 needs to include the local representative in Curacao. Amend and resubmit form.

items.title: Compliance Officer
items.description: No CO appointed. Appoint a compliance officer, fluent in AML and submit their PHDF as a key person, together with their CV and Letter of engagement. No Source of Wealth is required.

items.title: Business Plan
items.description: Please resubmit business plan in line with the guidelines issued.
